_doc: stradl / Perch identity spec. Every deliverable is generated from this file by build.py. Ratios are in units of s = seat (tile) edge length.

ultra.use: the session disc on light surfaces (primary brand colour)

ultraLight.use: the session disc on dark surfaces

mint.use: status only: 'in sync' on light surfaces

mintLight.use: status only: 'in sync' on dark surfaces

_rules: two equal seats, s x s, on a rising diagonal (lower-left + upper-right)
the seats touch at exactly one point: the seam; the disc centre IS the seam
all three outer corners of a seat are identical continuous corners (R = 185/824 s, smoothing 0.6, i.e. the macOS app-icon body scaled down)
the seam corner of each seat is cut by a concave arc of radius rk = disc + ring, with sharp (unfilleted) joins so it reads as occlusion
mark bounding box = 2s x 2s; the disc is never moved off the seam in the static mark

small16._doc: hand-fitted full-colour master for 16-24 px (favicon, Finder list, Spotlight). 16-unit grid, seats on whole pixels, 4 px disc on whole pixels, ring 1.5 px at 16 px. From 32 px up use the 512 master (at 32 px its seats land on whole pixels too).

menubar._doc: macOS template, 22 pt @2x on a 44-unit grid. Span 32 units (16 pt) so it sits with SF Symbols weight. #000000 + alpha only.

menubar16._doc: template for 16 pt contexts, 16 pt @2x on a 32-unit grid; seats land on whole pixels at 16 px.

wordmark.custom: s terminals squared to horizontal cuts (matches the flat t, the vertical r cut and the d/l stems)

_rules: mark is centred on the baseline-to-ascender band (top of d / l), so it overshoots both lines by the same 5% of its height, like round letters do
gap from mark to the s = 0.6 x-height
clear space on every side = 0.5 x-height
